data.gender_notes: Haashim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haashim is a name that symbolizes the destruction of evil and the triumph of good. It is a powerful and meaningful name in Islamic tradition. The name Haashim carries the meaning “Destroyer of evil” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haashim usually hope their child will grow to embody destroyer of evil and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Haashim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Destroyer of evil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haashim total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: هاشم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من هشمة، يعني من يقوم بتكسير وطحن الحجارة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم هاشم مشتق من الجذر العربي هشم، والذي يعني تكسير وطحن الحجارة. يرتبط هذا الاسم بالشخص الذي يقوم بهذا العمل، وهو ما يعرف بالحجر. في التاريخ الإسلامي، كان هاشم بن عبد مناف جد النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وكان معروفًا بكرمه وجوده. هذا الاسم يحمل معاني القوة والقدرة على تحمل المسؤوليات.

in_urdu.name: ہاشم
in_urdu.meaning: ہاشم کا مطلب ہے پتھروں کو توڑنے والا یا پیسنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہاشم نام عربی زبان کے جذر هشم سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پتھروں کو توڑنا یا پیسنا۔ یہ نام ان شخصیتوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو مضبوط اور مستحکم ہیں۔ تاریخی طور پر، ہاشم بن عبد مناف النبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے جد تھے اور ان کی نسل میں ایک اہم شخصیت کے طور پر جانے جاتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: हाशिम
in_hindi.meaning: हाशिम का अर्थ है पत्थरों को तोड़ने वाला या पीसने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: हाशिम नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल هشم से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है पत्थरों को तोड़ना या पीसना। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो मजबूत और स्थिर हैं। ऐतिहासिक रूप से, हाशिम बिन अब्द मन्नाफ पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के दादा थे और उनकी वंशावली में एक महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्ति के रूप में जाने जाते हैं।

in_english.name: Haashim
in_english.meaning: Breaker of stones, crusher, or grinder
in_english.long_meaning: The name Haashim originates from the Arabic root هشم (h-sh-m), which means to break or crush stones. It refers to someone who is strong and capable of handling heavy tasks. Historically, Haashim bin Abd al-Manaf was a respected ancestor of the Prophet Muhammad, known for his generosity and leadership. The name symbolizes strength, resilience, and the ability to overcome challenges. It carries a sense of responsibility and power.

data.cultural_impact: The name Haashim is a noble Arabic name with a rich cultural heritage. Haashim is an honorable name among the Arabs, particularly the Banu Hashim tribe, to whom the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) belonged. The name is deeply rooted in Islamic history and represents the values of courage, generosity, and strength. Haashim is a name that inspires a sense of pride and identifies its bearer as part of a glorious and noble lineage.
data.spiritual_significance: Haashim is a name with profound spiritual significance. It derives from the name of Prophet Ibrahim's (Abraham) prominent ancestor, Imam Hassan Al-Askari, the 11th Imam of the Twelver Shia branch of Islam. The name Haashim signifies the struggle against evil and the triumph of good, as Imam Hassan Al-Askari was known for his unwavering commitment to the truth and his courage in the face of adversity. The name serves as a reminder of the importance of faith, perseverance, and the moral struggle against the forces of evil in the world. Additionally, Haashim can also be connected to the virtue of justice, as guided by Imam Ali (as), the fourth caliph and martyr of Islam. Therefore, the name Haashim inspires a deep sense of spiritual and moral values, strengthening the bearer's beliefs and guiding them to lead a virtuous and honorable life.
